tagline: Discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines that help patients prevail over serious diseases
hero_kpi_rationale: The Growth Portfolio is BMY's primary growth driver, offsetting generic erosion in the Legacy Portfolio. It includes innovative therapies such as Opdivo, Breyanzi, and Camzyos, which benefit from patent protection and strong clinical demand.

kpis.name: Total Revenues
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from the sale of drugs and treatments.
kpis.description: Revenues remained stable in 2025 at $48.2 billion, with growth in the innovative portfolio offsetting the impact of generics.

kpis.name: Non-GAAP EPS
kpis.explanation: Earnings per share, excluding exceptional items.
kpis.description: Non-GAAP EPS increased from $1.15 to $6.15 in 2025, driven by cost savings and lower amortization charges.

kpis.name: Growth Portfolio Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated by recent innovative drugs including Opdivo, Breyanzi, and Camzyos.
kpis.description: The growth portfolio saw increased demand in 2025, supported by Opdivo, Breyanzi, and other recent therapies.

kpis.name: Cost Savings Initiative
kpis.explanation: Targeted savings achieved through internal restructuring and the productivity initiative launched in 2025.
kpis.description: BMY targets $2 billion in savings by end of 2027 through its productivity initiative launched in 2025.

kpis.name: R&D Locations
kpis.explanation: Number of sites globally where research and development is conducted.
kpis.description: BMY operates 8 R&D sites in total, with 7 in the United States and 1 internationally.

kpis.name: Manufacturing Sites
kpis.explanation: Number of drug manufacturing plants worldwide.
kpis.description: The company operates 8 manufacturing sites, with 4 in the United States and 4 internationally.

kpis.name: Regulatory Approvals
kpis.explanation: Number of approvals obtained for new drugs or indications in 2025.
kpis.description: In 2025, BMY obtained 7 major approvals: Breyanzi (FDA for MZL, EC for MCL), Camzyos (Japan), Opdivo+Yervoy (HCC and MSI-High colorectal), Opdivo (NSCLC perioperative), Opdivo Qvantig (multiple solid tumors), Augtyro (Japan).

kpis.name: Strategic Initiatives
kpis.explanation: Number of key acquisitions, licenses, or partnerships completed in 2025.
kpis.description: In 2025, BMY executed 4 strategic initiatives: acquisition of Orbital Therapeutics (OTX-201 CAR-T), collaboration with BioNTech (pumitamig for solid tumors), exclusive license from Philochem (OncoACP3 radiopharmaceutical), and opening of a radiopharmaceutical manufacturing plant in Indianapolis.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale.

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions.
kpis.description: Cumulative dividends + buybacks (2021-2025) in billions USD. Source yfinance cashflow.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du résultat net redistribuée. >80 % = potentiellement non soutenable.

risks.title: Foreign exchange risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to significant foreign exchange risk due to its international operations, with substantial exposure to fluctuations in the euro and Japanese yen.

risks.title: Interest rate risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to interest rate risk due to its debt structure and financial investments.

risks.title: Credit risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to credit risk due to its investments and financing operations.

risks.title: Competition risk
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a highly competitive sector with risks of market share loss due to generics and new competitors.

risks.title: Regulatory and pricing risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict regulations and increasing pricing pressures (Inflation Reduction Act, Medicare negotiations, US government agreement).

ai_positioning.summary: BMY does not explicitly mention artificial intelligence (AI) or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F filing. The information provided focuses primarily on product sales, research and development, and collaborations, with no specific reference to AI.
